CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #1
====

GRADE: Grade 6
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of Miracles of Jesus Christ? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Miracles of Jesus Christ with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use Miracles of Jesus Christ to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Miracles of Jesus Christ.
   D. Say Miracles of Jesus Christ has no place in daily life.

2. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Destroy trees without planting
   B. Pollute rivers deliberately
   C. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   D. Waste food daily

3. Which response best shows understanding of Miracle of Healing? (1 mark)
   A. Use Miracle of Healing to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Miracle of Healing.
   C. Say Miracle of Healing has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of Miracle of Healing with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

4. Which response best shows understanding of Marriage and Family? (1 mark)
   A. Say Marriage and Family has no place in daily life.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Marriage and Family.
   C. Use Marriage and Family to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Apply the teaching of Marriage and Family with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

5. Which response best shows understanding of Leisure? (1 mark)
   A. Use Leisure to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Leisure.
   C. Say Leisure has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of Leisure with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

6. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Cheating in exams
   B. Spreading rumours
   C. Hiding stolen items
   D. Telling the truth and keeping trust

7. Which response best shows understanding of The Temptations of Jesus Christ? (1 mark)
   A. Use The Temptations of Jesus Christ to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Say The Temptations of Jesus Christ has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The Temptations of Jesus Christ.
   D. Apply the teaching of The Temptations of Jesus Christ with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

8. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   B. Skipping all moral lessons
   C. Refusing to help a neighbour
   D. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school

9. Which response best shows understanding of The Ten Commandments? (1 mark)
   A. Use The Ten Commandments to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Say The Ten Commandments has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The Ten Commandments.
   D. Apply the teaching of The Ten Commandments with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

10. Which response best shows understanding of The Call of Disciples? (1 mark)
   A. Use The Call of Disciples to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The Call of Disciples.
   C. Apply the teaching of The Call of Disciples with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Say The Call of Disciples has no place in daily life.

11. Which response best shows understanding of My Purpose? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of My Purpose with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say My Purpose has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing My Purpose.
   D. Use My Purpose to insult classmates of other faiths.

12. Which response best shows understanding of Inspired Word of God? (1 mark)
   A. Use Inspired Word of God to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of Inspired Word of God with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Inspired Word of God.
   D. Say Inspired Word of God has no place in daily life.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Church Unity 5 5.0 Christian Living Today 5.1 Friendship Formation 6 5.2 Human S and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Church Unity and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Friendship Formation 6 5.2 Human Sexuality 7 5.3 Sanctity of Life 4 5.4 Alcohol, and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Friendship Formation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
